abstract: A total of 85 patients underwent modified retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis from 1982 to 1989. The technique was a modified bilateral dissection via a thoracoabdominal approach. A full bilateral dissection was done above the level of the inferior mesenteric artery but unilateral dissection was performed below the inferior mesenteric artery using a template method. Of the 85 patients 64 had pathological stage A and 21 had stage B1 disease. Relapses have occurred in 4 of 64 stage A cancer patients (6%) and 3 of 21 stage B1 cancer patients (15%). Antegrade ejaculation was preserved without pharmacological therapy in 75 of 85 patients (88%) and 5 others were converted to antegrade ejaculation with imipramine. Therefore, 80 of 85 patients (94%) have recovered antegrade ejaculation. With a median followup of 38 months 7 relapses have been noted. We conclude that modified retroperitoneal lymph node dissection allows for preservation of ejaculation, decreases concern about retroperitoneal understaging and represents the preferred alternative to surveillance protocols for patients with low stage testicular cancer.
abstract_ja: 1982年から1989年の間に、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の精巣に対して85例が修正後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた。術式は胸腹部アプローチによる修正両側郭清であった。下腸間膜動脈より上位は両側の完全郭清を行い、下位は片側郭清をテンプレート法で行った。85例中64例は病理病期A、21例は病理病期B1であった。再発は病理病期A患者64例中4例(6%)、病理病期B1患者21例中3例(15%)に生じた。順行性射精は85例中75例(88%)で薬剤なしに温存され、さらに5例はイミプラミンにより順行性射精に回復した。したがって85例中80例(94%)が順行性射精を回復した。追跡期間中央値38か月で、計7例の再発が認められた。修正後腹膜リンパ節郭清は射精機能を温存し、後腹膜の過小評価への懸念を減らし、病期の低い精巣がんに対して監視療法に代わる望ましい選択肢であると結論する。
